description: Governed PP ID -> human-readable Primary Source Set mapping, sourced verbatim from the Population Registry (never a second PP/case authority -- consulted only for display, after population_id has already been resolved through the existing EvaluationCaseResolver / retrieval path). Each value is copied exactly as recorded in the Registry's 'Primary Source Set' column, with no expansion of abbreviations, no inference, and no invented text.
